build_roi_head: build a StandardROIHeadsPseudoLab ROI head with box pooler, box head, and box predictor from config
run_forward_inference: run the forward method on StandardROIHeadsPseudoLab to get predicted instances and predictions
run_forward_training: run the forward method on StandardROIHeadsPseudoLab to compute training losses with labeled proposals
run_forward_val_loss: run the forward method on StandardROIHeadsPseudoLab to compute validation losses without appending ground truth
label_and_sample_proposals: label and sample proposals using StandardROIHeadsPseudoLab.label_and_sample_proposals with targets and branch name
